name: Google AI Studio
description: aistudio.google.com on 21 October 2026 was titled “Google AI Studio” and described as the fastest path from prompt to production with Gemini. Separate Gemini API docs list a free token tier and paid rates. Those API rates are not a consumer subscription price.
